title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: employer-sponsored Corporate Guest Pass allotment
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, while a corporate wellness enrollment is active, that employee's employer may sponsor up to the tier's monthly allotment of Corporate Guest Pass day passes at no charge to the employee. A sponsored guest pass beyond that monthly allotment is charged the tier's per-pass fee instead of being provided at no charge.

Stated as condition and action: within a given month, a sponsored guest pass that falls inside the tier's remaining monthly allotment is provided at no charge; a sponsored guest pass beyond that allotment in the same month is charged the tier's per-pass fee.

The size of the monthly allotment and the fee charged per pass beyond it both vary by partnership tier and are stated in a separate document.
